descriptionHtml:
Custom Food Booth Canopy Tent Package 10x10

Make your food stand unforgettable with our premium 10x10 Custom Canopy Tent Package, designed especially for food vendors, farmers’ markets, and outdoor events. This compact, professional-grade canopy combinesdurability, ventilation, and full customizationto help your booth stand out from the crowd.

Key Features:

🏕️ Product Size: 120" W x 137" H x 120" D – spacious 10x10 setup for larger vendor spaces.

💪 Durable Frame: Heavy-duty aluminum frame with ABS nylon hardware for stability and long-lasting use.

🎨 Custom Printing: Full-color dye-sublimation printing on canopy top and walls for vibrant, fade-resistant branding.

🧱 Half Side Walls with Mesh: Solid fabric bottoms and mesh tops for airflow and customer visibility.

🪟 Front Wall with Two Serving Windows: Designed for efficient food service and interaction.

🚪 Left Wall with Window & Zippered Doorway: Convenient access plus ventilation.

🧵 Full Fabric Back Wall: Printed inward for a clean, professional interior.

🔁 Double-Sided Printing Upgrade: Optional upgrade available to maximize brand exposure on all walls.

☀️ Weather-Resistant Canopy: Made of 600 Denier Polyester, UV-protected and waterproof.

⚙️ Quick Pop-Up Design: Tool-free assembly — ready in minutes.

🧳 Wheeled Carry Bag Included: Easy transport and storage for the frame.

🎁 Complete Package: Frame, canopy top, printed walls, wheeled carry bag, free design service, and fast delivery.

6' Table Cover

Sandbags

Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum

Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Outdoor events, food festivals, farmers’ markets, trade shows, and pop-up shops
